```lean
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  let hA∞ := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ hA∞ (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  calc _
    _ = ∂ₜ (fun t => 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x - 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c t x i) t := by
      conv_lhs => enter [1]
      change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
      enter [t]
      rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA∞ _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂ₜ (fun t => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub, fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
          fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      congr
      funext j
      rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      exact (hBt j).differentiableAt
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (j, i)) t)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr
      rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      congr
      funext j
      rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
      apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
      apply hA∞
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x - ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      congr
      funext j
      congr
      funext x
      rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA∞]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x -
          ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      congr
      funext j
      rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub (Space.deriv_differentiable (electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) hA∞ t) j).differentiableAt
          (Space.deriv_differentiable (electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) hA∞ t) j).differentiableAt]
      rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[i] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
      congr
      funext j
      rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) hA∞ t)]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr
      rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum]
      simp only [_root_.sum_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      intro j _
      exact (Space.deriv_differentiable (electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) hA∞ t) j).differentiableAt
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ ^ 2) * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr 2
      rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix] at h
      conv_lhs => enter [2, 2, x]
      rw [(h t x).1]
      trans 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * Space.deriv i (fun x => (1/ 𝓕.ε₀) * LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x
      · congr
        funext x
        ring
      · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_const_mul]
        simp only [ _root_.smul_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
        apply LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        exact hJ.differentiable (by decide)
      · exact hA
      · exact hJ
    _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
          𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
          𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      simp only [ FreeSpace.c_sq]
      field_simp
```
